   156	def canonical_value(type: Type, value):
   157	    """Validate a JSON value against a type and normalise it.
   158	
   159	    No truncation or padding is applied: string constants keep embedded NULs,
   160	    which makes them distinct from the value recovered from a symbolic string
   161	    object of the same bytes.
   162	    """
   163	    base = underlying(type)
   164	    if isinstance(base, Bool):
   165	        _need(value.__class__ is bool, "boolean value expected")
   166	        return value
   167	    if isinstance(base, Char):
   168	        _need(isinstance(value, str) and len(value) == 1
   169	              and 0 <= ord(value) <= 255, "character value expected")
   170	        return value
   171	    if isinstance(base, Int):
   172	        _need(value.__class__ is int and 0 <= value < base.limit,
   173	              "integer value out of range")
   174	        return value
   175	    if isinstance(base, String):
   176	        _need(isinstance(value, str) and len(value) <= base.maxsize,
   177	              "string constant too long")
   178	        for char in value:
   179	            _need(0 <= ord(char) <= 255, "string constant must be Latin-1")
   180	        return value
   181	    if isinstance(base, Enum):
   182	        _need(isinstance(value, str) and value in base.values,
   183	              "enum value expected")
   184	        return value
   185	    if isinstance(base, Array):
   186	        _need(isinstance(value, list) and len(value) == base.size,
   187	              "array value expected")
   188	        return [canonical_value(base.element_type, item) for item in value]
   189	    if isinstance(base, Struct):
   190	        _need(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value.keys()) == set(base.fields),
   191	              "struct value expected")
   192	        return {field: canonical_value(ftype, value[field])
   193	                for field, ftype in base.fields.items()}
   194	    if isinstance(base, Void):
   195	        _need(value is None, "void has no value")
   196	        return None
   197	    raise InvalidCampaign("unsupported type")

   200	def deep_equal(left, right) -> bool:
   201	    """Deep, type strict comparison used by `eq` and `ne`."""
   202	    if left is right:
   203	        return True
   204	    kind = type(left)
   205	    if kind is not type(right):
   206	        return False
   207	    if kind is bool or kind is int or kind is str:
   208	        return left == right
   209	    if kind is list:
   210	        if len(left) != len(right):
   211	            return False
   212	        for one, two in zip(left, right):
   213	            if not deep_equal(one, two):
   214	                return False
   215	        return True
   216	    if kind is dict:
   217	        if left.keys() != right.keys():
   218	            return False
   219	        for key in left:
   220	            if not deep_equal(left[key], right[key]):
   221	                return False
   222	        return True
   223	    return left == right

   231	def build_types(definitions) -> dict:
   232	    """Resolve the declared type list into a name -> Type table."""
   233	    if not isinstance(definitions, list):
   234	        raise InvalidCampaign("types must be a list")
   235	    table = {}
   236	    pending = []
   237	    for definition in definitions:
   238	        _need(isinstance(definition, dict), "type definition must be an object")
   239	        name = _identifier(definition.get("name"))
   240	        kind = definition.get("kind")
   241	        _need(isinstance(kind, str), "type kind must be a string")
   242	        _need(name not in table, "duplicate type name")
   243	        if kind == "bool":
   244	            type = Bool()
   245	        elif kind == "char":
   246	            type = Char()
   247	        elif kind == "int":
   248	            bits = _integer(definition.get("bits"))
   249	            _need(1 <= bits <= 64, "int bits out of range")
   250	            type = Int(bits)
   251	        elif kind == "string":
   252	            maxsize = _integer(definition.get("maxsize"))
   253	            _need(0 <= maxsize <= 512, "string maxsize out of range")
   254	            type = String(maxsize)
   255	        elif kind == "enum":
   256	            values = definition.get("values")
   257	            _need(isinstance(values, list) and values, "enum values expected")
   258	            for value in values:
   259	                _need(isinstance(value, str) and value and value.isascii()
   260	                      and value.isprintable() and len(value) <= 64,
   261	                      "enum value must be printable ASCII")
   262	            _need(len(set(values)) == len(values), "duplicate enum value")
   263	            type = Enum(name, values)
   264	        elif kind == "array":
   265	            size = _integer(definition.get("size"))
   266	            _need(0 <= size <= 4096, "array size out of range")
   267	            type = Array(None, size)
   268	            pending.append((type, "element", definition.get("element")))
   269	        elif kind == "struct":
   270	            type = Struct(name)
   271	            fields = definition.get("fields")
   272	            _need(isinstance(fields, list), "struct fields must be a list")
   273	            _need(len(fields) <= 16, "too many struct fields")
   274	            pairs = []
   275	            for entry in fields:
   276	                _need(isinstance(entry, list) and len(entry) == 2,
   277	                      "struct field pair expected")
   278	                field = _identifier(entry[0])
   279	                target = entry[1]
   280	                _need(isinstance(target, str), "field type name expected")
   281	                _need(all(field != other for other, _ in pairs),
   282	                      "duplicate struct field")
   283	                pairs.append((field, target))
   284	            pending.append((type, "fields", pairs))
   285	        elif kind == "alias":
   286	            type = Alias(name, None)
   287	            pending.append((type, "target", definition.get("target")))
   288	        elif kind == "void":
   289	            type = Void()
   290	        else:
   291	            raise InvalidCampaign("unknown type kind")
   292	        type.decl = name
   293	        table[name] = type
   294	    # Second pass links forward references; aggregates never contain void.
   295	    for type, role, payload in pending:
   296	        if role == "fields":
   297	            resolved = {}
   298	            for field, target in payload:
   299	                _need(target in table, "unknown struct field type")
   300	                child = table[target]
   301	                _need(not isinstance(underlying(child), Void),
   302	                      "aggregate contains void")
   303	                resolved[field] = child
   304	            type.fields = resolved
   305	        else:
   306	            _need(isinstance(payload, str), "type reference expected")
   307	            _need(payload in table, "unknown type reference")
   308	            child = table[payload]
   309	            if role == "element":
   310	                _need(not isinstance(underlying(child), Void),
   311	                      "aggregate contains void")
   312	                type.element_type = child
   313	            else:
   314	                _need(not isinstance(child, Void), "alias to void")
   315	                type.type = child
   316	    _check_acyclic(table)
   317	    _check_depth(table)
   318	    return table
   319	
   320	
   321	def _children(type):
   322	    if isinstance(type, Alias):
   323	        return (type.type,)
   324	    if isinstance(type, Array):
   325	        return (type.element_type,)
   326	    if isinstance(type, Struct):
   327	        return tuple(type.fields.values())
   328	    return ()

   330	
   331	def _check_acyclic(table):
   332	    colour = {}
   333	    for root in table:
   334	        if colour.get(root):
   335	            continue
   336	        stack = [(root, iter(_children(table[root])))]
   337	        colour[root] = 1
   338	        while stack:
   339	            node, walker = stack[-1]
   340	            for child in walker:
   341	                name = child.decl
   342	                if colour.get(name) == 1:
   343	                    raise InvalidCampaign("cyclic type graph")
   344	                if colour.get(name) == 2:
   345	                    continue
   346	                colour[name] = 1
   347	                stack.append((name, iter(_children(table[name]))))
   348	                break
   349	            else:
   350	                colour[node] = 2
   351	                stack.pop()
   352	
   353	
   354	def _check_depth(table):
   355	    depth = {}
   356	    for root in table:
   357	        if root in depth:
   358	            continue
   359	        stack = [(root, 0)]
   360	        while stack:
   361	            node, level = stack.pop()
   362	            current = depth.get(node)
   363	            if current is not None and current >= level:
   364	                continue
   365	            depth[node] = level
   366	            for child in _children(table[node]):
   367	                stack.append((child.decl, level + 1))
   368	    for name, level in depth.items():
   369	        _need(level <= MAX_DEPTH, "type nesting too deep")
